phase: Phase 8 — Existing Mechanism Manifestation Gap Audit
purpose: Record only manifestation leads already evidenced in repository artifacts; this is not mining, realization, or admission.

P4.potential_structure: Change ordering, transaction count, certificate applicability, or fallback-resource coverage while preserving one-shot allocation reasoning.
P4.evidence_assessment: The policy/backend artifacts establish one-shot removal and the scan establishes many native parameters, but the selected/known clean states all use the same cheap-first two-booking geometry.

LGA01.potential_structure: A cabin-change permission is overridden by lifecycle state after a segment has flown.
LGA01.blocking_reason: The native update rejects landed/flying instances; replacing flown segments also violates the same-flights scope.

LGA01.potential_structure: A purported specific inclusion inside a broader cabin-change permission.
LGA01.blocking_reason: The broader rule already covers all reservations, so this is not a clean distinct hidden precedence manifestation.

P3.manifestation_value: No new manifestation; duplicates the existing cancellation-refund to whole-order payment-replacement structure.

P3.blocking_reason: Return and delivered-exchange requests do not immediately credit the gift-card balance, so no mutation-induced resource refresh exists.

P3.potential_structure: Consume a refreshed resource through an operation other than whole-order payment replacement or item-upgrade delta payment.

LGA04.potential_structure: Passenger-edit authorization does not extend to changing reservation passenger count.
LGA04.blocking_reason: The tool rejects unequal passenger-list length and exposes the restriction in its schema.

LGA04.potential_structure: A baggage-change operation's apparent scope excludes baggage removal.
LGA04.blocking_reason: Concealment would amount to hiding a standalone prohibition rather than a clean latent scope boundary.

LGA04.potential_structure: Item modification stays within the original product rather than allowing arbitrary product substitution.
LGA04.blocking_reason: Variant lookup and tool schema enforce same-product scope before mutation.

audit_conclusion: Existing artifacts contain useful target and negative evidence, but no unused candidate is already ready for direct clean-task realization. A subsequent targeted mining phase must re-establish native/backend/evaluator suitability.
